status: Frozen after source inspection and before native policy execution
candidate: Definedness of a set-valued deny rule versus a denied authorization decision
source_informed_selection: Lexicographically first Rego repository abhishekbagde__apex-platform, claude-sonnet-5 policy, gpt-5.4 test source. It contains a partial-set deny rule and bare deny expressions in several negative tests. Selection and hypothesis follow inspection, not a random or blinded test.
hypothesis: A bare set-valued deny expression may satisfy an OPA test when the set is empty; such a test may keep passing when the same request becomes allowed under a default-allow policy mutation.
controls: First a standalone authored language fixture: allow true, deny empty set, bare deny test, not-allow test. Then the unchanged artifact policy and unchanged rendered test suite, and a separately copied policy differing only in default allow=false to default allow=true. Explicitly evaluate the same Reader assign_role request's allow and deny values in both policies.
native_runtime: Official OPA v1.22.4 linux_amd64_static, published 12 November 2026. Verify publisher asset SHA256 35e3b352e715e80624ead6c89930d8585f6f7d94cdc409eb2a9fe36620dcccba. This is a pinned qualification runtime, not an established original-paper runtime.
execution_boundary: WSL Ubuntu, bubblewrap private filesystem and network namespace, selected case files read-only, no credentials/home mount, bounded command timeout. No model/provider calls.
measurements: Native parser/test exit codes, every test name/pass/fail, explicit allow boolean and deny set for the selected fixed request. Compare original versus mutant per test. Passing a weak individual test is not the same as an undetected whole-suite mutant.
limitations: One source-informed native witness. No prevalence, general oracle accuracy, wrong-published-score, new mutation-testing algorithm or field-wide priority claim. Only a measured artifact-specific increment can support a later scoped preprint. External review is not a publication prerequisite.
source_policy: Original acquired policies/tests remain unchanged. Generated mutants and authored controls are separate outputs with hashes. No raw dataset redistribution without established terms.
